description: Source files whose line and branch coverage must not fall in a pull request that prunes tests. They move or lock money, check or make signatures, handle keys, or decode chain data. scripts/coverage-diff reads this list, compares the coverage of the base and the head, and exits 1 when one of these files loses coverage. Each path is a tracked source file below <package>/src/. A UI file, a CLI entry point that no test loads, a configuration module, and a file whose uncovered branches change between two runs of the same code (for example buyer/src/paper2agent/model.ts) are not in the list.
